content: Original: a simple hand-drawn scene on an off-white background — an original round-headed stick-figure character standing at lower-left-centre (head near screen (627, 700)) beside an original prop (e.g. a large clay pot) to the right; add fine static texture (paper grain, small grass tufts) over the whole frame so the camera is trackable. Thick dark jittered outlines, flat fills.
timeline: f45: HARD single-frame punch-in: the SAME artwork (no redraw, no new elements) instantly scaled by 2.14 about the fixed screen point (627, 818); no in-between frames, no easing.
f46-89: hold the punched-in framing completely static.
rules: You see only this spec. No source frames are provided or allowed. Python numpy/opencv/PIL + ffmpeg (h264 yuv420p). Render the artwork once on a large canvas and derive both framings from it by affine warp.
